name: Higgs Audio v3 STT
blurb: Whisper-Large-v3 audio encoding with Qwen3 decoding — a compact Apache-2.0 family near the top of the Open ASR Leaderboard.
about: Higgs Audio v3 STT combines a Whisper-Large-v3 encoder with a Qwen3 language-model decoder. The 2.68B checkpoint records 4.62% average cleaned WER in the current independent Open ASR Leaderboard results, while an 8.91B sibling reaches 4.73%; both sit among the strongest openly downloadable English ASR systems measured there.

Boson AI released the family under Apache 2.0 and provides custom Transformers-compatible model code, with the smaller checkpoint refreshed in June 2026. It is English-only and GPU-oriented rather than an edge model, but its strong accuracy-to-size trade-off makes it a practical alternative to larger speech-language-model systems when multilingual coverage is not required.
install:
pip install -U "transformers>=4.51" torch accelerate

python -c "
from transformers import AutoModel, AutoTokenizer
m = AutoModel.from_pretrained('bosonai/higgs-audio-v3-stt', trust_remote_code=True, device_map='auto')
t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('bosonai/higgs-audio-v3-stt')"
